note: Compiled joint rotations for every known handshape, right hand. Used by the motion pipeline to classify an extracted hand and to supply the handshape prior.

A.description: Closed fist, thumb upright along the index side.

B.description: Four fingers straight and together, thumb across the palm.

C.description: Fingers and thumb curved into a C.

D.description: Index straight, other fingers meeting the thumb.

E.description: Fingers curled down onto a tucked thumb.

F.description: Thumb and index pinched, other three fingers straight.

G.description: Index pointing sideways, thumb parallel below it.

H.description: Index and middle pointing sideways together.

J.description: Pinky extended, tracing a J. Handshape only; movement is a clip.

K.description: Index up, middle angled out, thumb between them.

L.description: Index up and thumb out, forming an L.

M.description: Three fingers folded over the thumb; tip shows between ring and little.

N.description: Two fingers folded over the thumb; tip shows between middle and ring.

O.description: Fingertips and thumb meeting in a circle.

P.description: K handshape rotated to point downward.

Q.description: G handshape rotated to point downward.

R.description: Index and middle crossed, middle passing behind the index.

S.description: Fist with the thumb clamped across the front.

T.description: Fist closed around a thumb wedged between index and middle.

U.description: Index and middle straight and together.

V.description: Index and middle straight and apart.

W.description: Index, middle and ring straight and spread.

Y.description: Thumb and pinky extended, middle fingers closed.

Z.description: Index extended, tracing a Z. Handshape only; movement is a clip.

FLAT.description: Flat hand, fingers together, thumb alongside.

BENT_FLAT.description: Fingers straight, bent forward at the knuckles.

ILY.description: Thumb, index and little finger extended.

FLAT_O.description: Flattened O: fingers together meeting the thumb.
